summary: A Yes vote increases the city's transactions and use (sales) tax by 0.375%, from 1.50% to 1.875%.

tax.text: A Yes vote increases the transactions and use tax by 0.375% and provides additional revenue for city streets, sidewalks, beach erosion, wildfire preparedness, trees, and other general government purposes.
tax.quote: shall the measure increasing the transactions and use tax (also known as sales tax) by 0.375%, from 1.50% to 1.875%, providing approximately $1,800,000 annually in additional revenue

tax.text: A No vote does not increase the transactions and use tax through this measure.
